concerns.text: T013 (I-VT algorithm) and T014 (Stimulus mapping) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on T012 (Geometry calibration/variable validation) which calculates the specific pixel-threshold and validates the schema. T012 must complete before T013/T014 can execute correctly. The [P] tag is incorrect here.

T015 (STAI merging) and T016 (Trial filtering) depend on the output of T013/T014 (fixation extraction and valence mapping). T015/T016 cannot run in parallel with T013/T014. The current grouping implies they might be parallel or independent, violating the data-flow dependency.

T024 (Monte Carlo power analysis) is listed as an implementation task within US2. However, SC-003 and Plan.md Phase 2.5 indicate this requires the *fitted model* (T020) and observed variance components. T024 must strictly follow T020 and T022 (LRT), not run in parallel or before them. The current ordering risks running power analysis on un-fitted or default parameters.

T028 (Marginal effects calculation) depends on the model coefficients from T020. T029 (Plot generation) depends on T028. T030 (Headless rendering) and T031 (Save plot) depend on T029. The current list implies a flat structure where T028-T031 might be parallel, but they form a strict linear chain: Model -> Calc -> Plot -> Render -> Save.

T006 (Schema validation contracts) is marked [P]. While creating the file is parallel, the *content* of the schema must be derived from the data-model (Plan.md Phase 1). If the data-model isn't finalized before T006 runs, the schema will be invalid. Ensure T006 is ordered after the data-model artifact is locked, or clarify that T006 is a 'skeleton' creation task.
